about.text: id="page" class="container" role="main"> About Daniel’s Wildlife & Pest Why I Started Daniel’s Wildlife and Pest Before starting my own company, I helped build and scale established pest and wildlife operations from the ground up. I was involved in developing service systems, training standards, and operational processes that supported their growth and reputation. As those companies expanded, quality declined. Services became rushed, problems were patched instead of properly solved, and customers were left dealing with repeat issues that should have been prevented the first time. Daniel’s Wildlife and Pest was created to return to high-standard, detail-driven work where accountability and results come first. When you hire me, you are not dealing with rotating technicians, sales-driven service plans, or shortcuts. You are working directly with the person responsible for the outcome of the job. Contact Today! Locally Owned and Owner-Operated I am the owner and the technician on every job. With over eight years of hands-on experience throughout the region, I have personally handled thousands of pest and wildlife cases across both residential and commercial properties. My work includes single-family homes, multi-unit buildings, property-managed communities, retail locations, offices, and specialty commercial sites. Licensed, Insured, and Professional I am fully licensed and insured, and all work is performed in accordance with applicable state and local requirements. This is especially important for commercial and managed properties where liability, documentation, and compliance matter. Built on Consistency, Transparency, and Results Homeowners, property managers, and commercial clients choose Daniel’s Wildlife and Pest because they want consistency, transparency, and results. Commercial clients in particular value reliability, communication, and accountability, and those expectations are built into how I operate from scheduling and access coordination to follow-through and long-term prevention. When you work with me, you are getting experienced, professional service from someone who takes personal responsibility for every job from start to finish. No shortcuts. No guesswork. Just clean, effective solutions designed to last. A Thorough Inspection Comes First Every service begins with a thorough inspection and an honest assessment of what is actually happening on the property. I evaluate animal behavior, insect activity, access points, structural conditions, sanitation issues, and environmental factors before recommending a plan. The goal is not just removal, but prevention that holds up over time. Trusted by Homeowners and Commercial Properties I am fully licensed and insured, and all work is performed in accordance with applicable state and local requirements. This is especially important for commercial and managed properties where liability, documentation, and compliance matter. Integrated Pest Management Approach My approach is based on integrated pest management principles. This means identifying why the problem started, what conditions allowed it to persist, and what needs to change to prevent future activity. Treatments are applied responsibly and strategically, with a focus on long-term effectiveness rather than unnecessary product use. No Quick Fixes. Real Solutions That Last. I do not believe in quick fixes, rushed services, or one-size-fits-all treatment plans. Effective pest and wildlife control requires strategy, experience, and attention to detail. Every property is different, and I design customized solutions that fully remove the issue while focusing on long-term prevention rather than temporary relief. Bird Control and Exclusion Specialists Bird control is a major area of specialization within my work. I provide pigeon control, solar panel bird exclusion, custom bird netting installations, and the safe removal of birds from vents and ventilation systems. These services require precise planning, proper materials, and correct installation to be effective long-term, and they are frequently mishandled by companies that do not specialize in bird work. Cleanup, Sanitation, and Damage Repair In addition to removal and exclusion, I provide cleanup, sanitation, and minor damage repair services. Wildlife and bird activity often leaves behind droppings, nesting material, odors, and harmful pathogens that must be addressed for a job to be truly complete. Structural sealing and exclusion work is performed using durable materials designed to prevent future entry. Services Bats Birds Learn more... Learn more... Gophers Insects Learn more... heads: Addressing Breeding Activity and Hidden Damage
Stop Raccoon Problems Before They Get Worse
Why Choose Daniel’s Wildlife and Pest?
raccoons.text: id="page" class="container" role="main"> Raccoon Removal & Exclusion Services Professional Raccoon Removal Services I provide professional, humane raccoon removal, trapping, and exclusion services designed to fully resolve the issue and prevent future entry. Every situation is different, and successful raccoon control requires a strategy based on the structure of the home or building, access points, and the behavior of the animals involved. My approach focuses on long-term results, not temporary fixes. Contact Today! What Damage Do Raccoons Cause? Raccoon activity often results in torn insulation, damaged ductwork, compromised wiring, and contamination from droppings and urine. Their presence can also create strong odors, noise disturbances, and unsafe conditions within attics and crawlspaces. When raccoons gain access to a structure, damage can escalate quickly and spread to multiple areas if the issue is not addressed properly. Cleanup and Damage Repair Services Cleanup and minor damage repair services are also available when raccoon activity has resulted in contamination or structural concerns. Addressing these areas is an important part of eliminating odors, reducing health risks, and preventing continued wildlife attraction. Inspection and Customized Removal Plans Each raccoon job begins with a detailed inspection to determine how the animals are getting in, how long the activity has been present, and what conditions are allowing it to continue. From there, I implement a customized plan that may include humane trapping when appropriate, along with additional removal and exclusion measures tailored specifically to the property. This ensures the raccoons are handled safely and effectively while protecting the structure from repeat problems. Addressing Breeding Activity and Hidden Damage Raccoon activity often involves breeding seasons, multiple access points, and hidden damage that is not always obvious at first glance. I take these factors into account when designing a solution so the issue is handled correctly the first time. Once the raccoons are removed, I secure active and potential entry points using durable materials intended to withstand future wildlife pressure. Stop Raccoon Problems Before They Get Worse If you are dealing with raccoons in your home or on your property, professional trapping, removal, and proper exclusion are critical to stopping the problem for good. birds.title: Birds | Northern Utah & Salt Lake Valley | Daniel's Wildlife & Pest Control
birds.meta: Humane bird control and exclusion services in Northern Utah and the Salt Lake Valley. We remove problem birds, clean nesting areas, and prevent re-entry.
birds.text: id="page" class="container" role="main"> Bird Removal & Exclusion Services Birds nesting in or around your home can lead to serious health risks, property damage, and persistent noise issues. Whether they’re in your attic, soffits, vents, or wall voids, birds leave behind droppings, nesting material, and parasites that contaminate air and damage structures. I offer safe, humane bird removal and exclusion services designed to fully eliminate the problem and stop it from coming back. A major focus of my bird work involves solar panel cleanouts, where pigeons and other birds often build dense nests underneath the panels. Over time, these areas fill with droppings, feathers, and waste. Bird pheromones left behind can continue to attract more birds, growing the infestation. In many cases, gutters become completely clogged, making them ineffective and leading to water damage, overflow, and staining near siding and entryways. With over 8 years of experience handling both nuisance birds and protected species, I do the job right—clean, legal, and built to last. Call Daniel’s Wildlife to schedule a full bird and solar panel inspection today. I provide full solar panel bird services including: • Removal of all birds and nesting materials from under and around panels • Elimination of pheromone traces to stop re-attraction • Roof, gutter, and ground-level cleanup of droppings and debris • Gutter clearing and sanitation to restore proper water drainage • Full sealing of solar panel edges to prevent access • Installation of bird deterrents to make rooftops less appealing In addition to rooftop bird work, I also: • Humanely remove birds from attics, soffits, vents, and walls • Remove hazardous nests located in areas that threaten human health • Replace soft ventilation passages (such as flex ducting and dryer vent hoses) that have been packed with nesting materials, restoring safe and proper airflow • Offer complete cleanup, sanitation, and exclusion to keep birds out for good Bats Learn more... Stop Bat Problems the Right Way

bats.text: id="page" class="container" role="main"> Bat Removal & Exclusion Services Professional Bat Removal and Exclusion Services I provide professional, safe, and humane bat removal and exclusion services that are fully compliant with Utah state regulations and federal protections for bat species. Bat work is highly regulated, and proper timing, planning, and execution are critical. I understand when and how bats can be legally excluded and ensure all work is performed in accordance with wildlife protection laws, including avoiding maternity seasons when young bats are unable to fly. Contact Today! What Problems Do Bats Cause? Bat activity inside structures can lead to guano accumulation, urine saturation, insulation contamination, and persistent odors. These conditions can negatively impact indoor air quality and create health risks for occupants. Because bat roosting often occurs in hidden or elevated areas, problems may continue unnoticed until contamination becomes significant. Inspection and Customized Bat Exclusion Plans Each bat service begins with a detailed inspection to identify active roosting areas, entry points, staining patterns, and signs of guano accumulation or contamination. Based on these findings, I develop a customized exclusion plan designed to allow bats to exit the structure safely while preventing re-entry. No harmful chemicals, poisons, or inappropriate trapping methods are ever used. Addressing Hidden Roosts and Long-Term Occupancy Bat activity often involves hidden roosts, multiple access points, and long-term occupancy that may not be obvious at first glance. These factors are carefully evaluated so the exclusion process is done correctly and does not create additional issues or legal concerns. Once the bats have fully vacated, all active and potential entry points are sealed using durable materials intended to provide lasting protection. Bat Cleanup and Sanitation Services Cleanup and sanitation services are available when bat activity has resulted in guano buildup, urine saturation, odors, or insulation contamination. Proper cleanup is an important part of restoring indoor air quality and reducing health risks associated with bat waste. Stop Bat Problems the Right Way If bats are roosting in or around your home or building, professional inspection and legally compliant exclusion are essential. Daniel’s Wildlife and Pest provides bat control solutions focused on safety, regulatory compliance, and long-term protection. Why Choose Daniel’s Wildlife and Pest? With over eight years of hands-on wildlife and pest control experience, I provide honest assessments and effective bat control solutions based on what the property actually needs. snakes.text: id="page" class="container" role="main"> Snake Removal & Exclusion Services Professional Snake Removal Services I provide fast, safe, and professional snake removal services for both non-venomous and venomous species found in Utah. All snake removals are performed using legal, humane techniques designed to protect occupants, pets, and the animal itself. If you encounter a snake and are unsure of the species, it is important not to attempt handling or removal on your own. Proper identification and controlled removal are critical for safety. Snake Deterrent and Prevention Services After removal, I offer comprehensive snake deterrent and prevention services designed to reduce future activity. These services may include habitat modification, reduction of food sources such as rodents or nesting birds, exclusion and sealing of entry points around garages, crawlspaces, and foundations, and the use of appropriate deterrent applications when needed. Contact Today! Inspection and Snake Control Plans Each snake service begins with an on-site inspection to locate the snake, assess surrounding conditions, and determine why the area is attracting activity. From there, I implement a removal and prevention plan tailored to the property. This approach reduces the likelihood of repeat encounters and provides long-term peace of mind rather than short-term relief. Experienced and Safe Snake Handling With over eight years of hands-on wildlife control experience in Utah, I am trained and prepared to safely handle everything from common garter snakes to rattlesnakes. My experience allows me to respond quickly, assess risk accurately, and resolve snake issues without creating unnecessary danger. Why Snakes Are Attracted to Properties Snakes are commonly drawn to residential and commercial properties when food sources, shelter, or favorable temperatures are present. Rodent activity, bird nesting, debris piles, rock features, and shaded structures can all increase snake activity. Because of this, effective snake control requires more than just removal. The conditions attracting snakes must also be addressed. Safe Snake Removal You Can Trust If you have a snakes on your property or are concerned about ongoing snake activity, professional inspection and removal are the safest way to handle the situation. termites.text: id="page" class="container" role="main"> Termite Inspection, Treatment, & Prevention Services Professional Termite Inspection & Control Services I provide complete termite services for residential and commercial properties, including active infestation treatment, long-term prevention, and certified termite inspections. Every termite service begins with a detailed inspection to determine whether activity is present, identify risk areas, and assess the overall condition of the structure. Targeted Termite Treatment Solutions When termites are active, I apply targeted liquid treatment solutions designed to eliminate the colony and stop further damage. These treatments are selected based on the construction of the structure, soil conditions, and the extent of activity to ensure effective control without unnecessary application. Contact Today! What Damage Do Termites Cause? Termites can cause extensive structural damage long before any visible signs appear. Because they feed from the inside out, infestations often remain hidden while wood framing, support structures, and other building components are compromised. By the time termite activity is discovered, damage may already be significant, requiring costly and invasive repairs. Without proper identification and treatment, termite damage can continue to spread throughout the structure. Stop Termite Damage Before It Spreads If you are concerned about termites or suspect activity on your property, early professional evaluation is essential. Proper inspection and targeted treatment help stop damage before it becomes widespread and more difficult to control. Daniel’s Wildlife and Pest provides reliable termite inspection, treatment, and prevention services focused on accurate assessment, effective protection, and long-term results. Termite Inspections for Real Estate Transactions I also provide termite inspections for real estate transactions, including WDI (wood destroying insect) reports required for financing, refinancing, or selling a home. These inspections meet lender requirements and provide clear, accurate documentation to help ensure a smooth closing process. Exterior Termite Risk and Contributing Conditions Termite activity is not always limited to the structure itself. I also address exterior termite concerns such as activity in fences, trees, sheds, wood piles, landscape timbers, and other conditions that can increase risk to the home. Identifying and correcting these issues is an important part of long-term protection. Why Choose Daniel’s Wildlife and Pest? gophers.text: id="page" class="container" role="main"> Gopher Control & Yard Protection Services Professional Gopher Control Services I provide professional gopher control services designed to eliminate active infestations and reduce the likelihood of future activity. My approach focuses on fast results while minimizing disruption to the surrounding landscape. Why Early Gopher Control Matters Gopher problems often worsen when activity is allowed to continue unchecked. Addressing the issue early helps prevent more extensive damage to lawns, landscaping, irrigation systems, and hardscape features, reducing the need for costly repairs and ongoing maintenance concerns. Contact Today! Inspection and Customized Treatment Plans Each gopher service begins with an evaluation of the property to identify active tunnel systems, feeding zones, and high-risk areas. Treatments are designed to address the current infestation while also discouraging new gophers from moving into the area. These options are commonly used for larger yards, landscaped properties, commercial grounds, and managed properties where gopher activity is persistent. What Damage Do Gophers Cause? Gopher tunneling can undermine soil stability, damage root systems, and compromise hardscape features over time. Their activity frequently results in uneven ground, dead grass, broken irrigation lines, and ongoing maintenance issues. When allowed to continue unchecked, gopher damage can worsen rapidly and lead to costly repairs. How Gopher Activity Spreads Across a Property Gopher activity often expands outward as tunnel systems grow and new feeding zones are established. What may begin as isolated mounds can quickly develop into widespread underground networks that impact lawns, landscaped areas, and hardscape features across the property. mice.meta: Humane mice control and exclusion services in Northern Utah and the Salt Lake Valley. We trap, bait, and seal your property to keep mice out year-round.
heads: Inspection and Customized Mouse Control Plans
Why Choose Daniel’s Wildlife and Pest?
mice.text: id="page" class="container" role="main"> Mouse Control & Exclusion Services Professional Mouse Control Services I provide comprehensive mouse control services for both interior and exterior infestations, designed to eliminate active mice and prevent future entry. Effective mouse control requires more than placing traps or bait. The source of the problem must be identified, access points secured, and pressure reduced on the structure over time. Contact Today! Mouse Trapping and Baiting Programs Control methods may include targeted exterior baiting using professional-grade products placed in tamper-resistant stations, as well as humane trapping in areas where baiting is not appropriate or where activity is localized. Interior control is approached carefully to eliminate activity while maintaining safety for occupants and pets. Mouse Exclusion and Seal-Up Services Exclusion is a critical part of long-term mouse control. Once active pressure is reduced, I seal entry points using durable, chew-resistant materials designed to prevent rodents from gaining access again. Addressing these vulnerabilities is essential to stopping repeat infestations. Inspection and Customized Mouse Control Plans Each mouse service begins with a detailed inspection of the entire property, including attics, crawlspaces, walls, garages, and exterior perimeter areas. This inspection identifies entry points, nesting locations, travel routes, and conditions that are allowing mice to enter and survive. Based on these findings, I develop a customized control plan tailored to the structure and severity of activity. Cleanup and Sanitation Services Mouse activity often leaves behind droppings, nesting debris, urine contamination, and damaged insulation. Cleanup and sanitation services are available to remove contamination, address odors, and restore affected areas to a clean and healthy condition. This step is especially important in attics and crawlspaces where activity may go unnoticed. What Damage Do Mice Cause? Mouse activity often results in chewed wiring, damaged insulation, and contamination from droppings and urine. Why Choose Daniel’s Wildlife and Pest?
rats.text: id="page" class="container" role="main"> Rat Control, Exclusion & Sanitization Services Professional Rat Control Services Rats are highly destructive pests that pose serious risks to both property and health. Once established, they chew through wiring, insulation, and structural materials, creating fire hazards and costly damage. Rat urine and droppings contaminate surfaces, spread harmful bacteria, and leave scent trails that attract additional rodents if not properly addressed. Unlike some pests, rats remain active year-round. They commonly nest under concrete slabs, sheds, decks, crawlspaces, and within walls or attics, often staying hidden while damage and contamination continue to build. Without professional intervention, rat problems tend to worsen over time and can spread throughout a structure or neighboring properties. Contact Today! Rat Trapping and Baiting Programs Control methods may include professional baiting programs using tamper-resistant stations placed strategically along exterior foundations, fences, and pressure points to reduce populations quickly. Safe and effective trapping is used in indoor areas or locations where baiting is not appropriate, ensuring targeted control without unnecessary risk. Rat Exclusion and Seal-Up Services Exclusion is essential for permanent rat control. Once activity is reduced, I perform full seal-up and exclusion work using durable, chew-resistant materials designed to block access and withstand continued rodent pressure. Proper exclusion prevents re-entry and stops new rats from moving in after removal. Professional Rat Control Services I provide comprehensive rat control services for both residential and commercial properties, combining aggressive removal with long-term prevention. Effective rat control requires identifying where rats are nesting, how they are accessing the structure, and what conditions are allowing them to survive and reproduce. What Damage Do Rats Cause? Rats can cause extensive property damage by chewing through wiring, insulation, and structural materials, which increases the risk of fire hazards and expensive repairs. They also create serious contamination concerns, as urine and droppings spread harmful bacteria and can impact indoor air quality and surface cleanliness. Scent trails left behind can attract additional rodents, making infestations harder to eliminate if not addressed properly. Inspection and Customized Rat Control Plans Each rat service begins with a detailed inspection of the entire property, including structures, foundations, crawlspaces, attics, sheds, and surrounding grounds. This inspection identifies active and potential entry points, nesting zones, burrows, and travel routes. Based on these findings, I design a customized removal and prevention plan tailored to the property and severity of activity. Stop Rat Damage Before It Gets Worse If you are seeing signs of rats or suspect activity on your property, professional control is the most effective way to eliminate the problem and prevent further damage. Daniel’s Wildlife and Pest provides reliable rat control solutions focused on elimination, prevention, and long-term protection. Why Choose Daniel’s Wildlife and Pest? Without proper control, vole populations can expand rapidly and cause widespread property damage. dead_animal_removal.text: id="page" class="container" role="main"> Dead Animal Removal & Sanitation Services A deceased animal in or around a home or building is more than an unpleasant situation. It is a serious health and sanitation concern that can quickly lead to strong odors, insect activity, and the spread of bacteria. Dead animals left inside walls, attics, crawlspaces, or on the property can contaminate surrounding materials and make living spaces unsafe if not handled properly. Professional Dead Animal Removal Services Daniel’s Wildlife and Pest provides fast, professional dead animal removal services with full cleanup and sanitation. Whether the animal is visible or you are only noticing an odor, I can locate the source, remove it safely, and address the contamination left behind. Locating Hidden Animals Dead animal situations often involve hidden locations such as wall voids, attics, crawlspaces, under decks, sheds, or landscaped areas. I use proven methods to locate carcasses efficiently and remove them with care and discretion. Proper handling and disposal are critical to preventing further health risks and pest activity. Common Dead Animal Removal Situations Common dead animal removals include raccoons, skunks, squirrels, rats, mice, birds, and snakes. These situations may occur naturally or as a result of previous pest activity, exclusion work, or environmental factors. Regardless of the cause, prompt removal is essential to limit damage and health concerns. Preventing Future Issues As part of the service, I inspect the surrounding area to determine how the animal gained access and whether additional prevention or exclusion work is recommended. Addressing entry points helps reduce the likelihood of future incidents and recurring odor issues.
